# Assets · Cards

12 files under `assets/Cards/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for card-hero-d.jpg>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

The money-green Payset card. `card-hero-d.jpg`, `repayset-3-cards-hero.png`, `debit-card-pset-1.png` and `debit-card-with-play-button-d.png` are hero and feature imagery. `iphone-virtual-cards-d.png`, `virtual-cards.png` and `virtual-cards-made-of-glass-d.png` show virtual cards.

The `mc-mask*` and `mask-virtual-card.png` files are black-ground production masks for card printing and rendering. Don't use them as page imagery.
